name: express
description: Track Chinese express parcels (SF, ZTO, YTO, STO, Yunda, J&T, EMS, JD, Deppon): auto-detect the carrier from a tracking number, fetch normalized tracking via your own Kuaidi100 or KDNiao API key, and keep a local watchlist with update polling. Tracking requires KUAIDI100_KEY + KUAIDI100_CUSTOMER or KDNIAO_API_KEY + KDNIAO_E_BUSINESS_ID. Missing keys and failed lookups return an error instead of invented events. Demo data is returned only when EXPRESS_DEMO=1 and is labeled as demo data. Unofficial; not affiliated with any carrier or API vendor.

KUAIDI100_KEY.title: 快递100 Key
KUAIDI100_KEY.description: 快递100 平台授权 Key（可选，用于高并发高精度查询）

KUAIDI100_CUSTOMER.title: 快递100 Customer ID
KUAIDI100_CUSTOMER.description: 快递100 企业商户编号（可选）

KDNIAO_API_KEY.title: 快递鸟 API Key
KDNIAO_API_KEY.description: 快递鸟平台 API Key（可选）

KDNIAO_E_BUSINESS_ID.title: 快递鸟 EBusinessID
KDNIAO_E_BUSINESS_ID.description: 快递鸟用户商户 ID（可选）

EXPRESS_DEFAULT_PROVIDER.title: 默认物流查询引擎
EXPRESS_DEFAULT_PROVIDER.description: 物流查询引擎选择 (auto, kuaidi100, kdniao, simulator)。simulator 仅在 EXPRESS_DEMO=1 时生效

EXPRESS_DEMO.title: 演示数据开关
EXPRESS_DEMO.description: 设为 1 时才返回标注为 demo data 的虚构轨迹。未设置时，缺密钥或查询失败会返回错误，不会编造轨迹

EXPRESS_DATA_DIR.title: 数据持久化目录
EXPRESS_DATA_DIR.description: 包裹监控清单和物流历史缓存保存目录（默认 ~/.grokbot/express）
